WITH november_starts AS (
  -- one row per session_start event on the Dublin days of November 2025, with its session ID and engaged flag
  SELECT user_pseudo_id,
         list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id,
         list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value AS session_engaged
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
),
sessions_seen AS (
  -- one row per session, a user_pseudo_id with a ga_session_id; a start with either ID missing is left out
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN session_engaged = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS engaged
  FROM november_starts
  WHERE user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
    AND ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(engaged) / COUNT(*), 1)
FROM sessions_seen
